name: Robe

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Riesling fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
